usedFor: AgentMail handles the inboxes that send and receive email; HubSpot holds the deals those emails relate to. A “New Email Received” in AgentMail can run “Create Deal” or “Update Deal” in HubSpot.

bestTemplate.name: “New Email Received” in AgentMail, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: An inbound message is the clearest sign of new interest among the triggers, and the action opens a deal so someone owns the reply.

watchOut: “Update Deal” needs the deal ID and the new field values, which an email event does not give you. “New Email Bounced” and “New Spam Complaint” make sense for updating a deal, not for creating one.
